# ORDERED

## Syntax

```synesis
FIELD <name> TYPE ORDERED
    SCOPE <scope>
    VALUES ... END VALUES
    [DESCRIPTION <text>]
    [GUIDELINES ... END GUIDELINES]
    [CONTEXT FROM DATASET <section>]
END FIELD
```

`[ ]` optional · `<>` value to replace

## Example

```synesis
FIELD example_ordered TYPE ORDERED
    SCOPE ITEM
    VALUES
        [1] low: low intensity
        [2] high: high intensity
    END VALUES
END FIELD
```

## Value in the annotation

The value written is the **index**, not the label:

```synesis
aspect: 11
```

The label (`Economic`) belongs to the template declaration and the editor shows it next to the index. It is not repeated in the annotation, because spelling variants (`economic`, `ECONOMIC`) would fragment the corpus. Writing the label is `SYNESIS_E088`.

## Properties

| Property | Status | Error if violated |
|---|---|---|
| `CONTEXT FROM DATASET` | Allowed | - |
| `DESCRIPTION` | Allowed | - |
| `GUIDELINES` | Allowed | - |
| `ARITY` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E055 |
| `FORMAT` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E054 |
| `RELATIONS` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E056 |
| `VALUES` | Required | SYNESIS_E049 |
